description:
NYC 'who is my landlord': the building's HPD Multiple Dwelling Registration by address. `borough` is one of
        manhattan, brooklyn, queens, bronx, staten-island; `address` is the street address with house number (e.g. '2400
        Davidson Ave'). Returns registration status (current or expired, end date), the registered owner (company name, or
        initials for a person), head officer and officers (initials), managing agent company, HPD violation counts (open by
        class A/B/C), the grantee on the newest ACRIS deed for comparison, and the HPD Online link with the full registration.
        status 'not_registered' means HPD has no registration on file (not 'no owner').
name: nyc_landlord_lookup
